methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper focuses on the interface between industry and its service providers in Finland to describe the current situation of barriers to energy efficiency improvement.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Qualitative interview study describing perceived barriers to energy efficiency improvement in the industry/service-provider interface. Energy performance measurement is mentioned only incidentally as a proposed remedy; no EnPI/EnB model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study comprised six case companies representing the pulp and paper, basic metals and petrochemicals industries and a total of 32 personal interviews.

stage1.notes: Interviewee sectors (pulp & paper, basic metals, petrochemicals) are an FN-lexicon hit, but the paper presents no EnPI/EnB model; ineligible, so level_3b is not applicable.
